Before Swan Maiden, the "Dance" mechanic was exclusive to premium 5-star heroes like Guardian Gazelle and later Odette. Bringing this to the 3-star level was a significant shift in power.

Even two years after the introduction of "modern" 3-stars, her utility is unmatched. Pure damage dealers fall out of favor, but unique mechanics like universal Dodge and Ailment Immunity remain timeless.

She is a staple in top-tier 3-star Rush Tournaments and heavily used in Bloody Battle (for the dodge/immunity, despite the heal blocking). She is one of the few 3-stars worth double limit breaking immediately.
